notes.title: Campaign for streamers for the demo version of Animaloid Girl!
notes.notes:
【Participating in the East Asia Indie Game Celebration!】
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/4a17dc657bb3e6aa44c8969bc9f3231284a6a648.jpg
“Animaloid Girl” will participate in the East Asia Indie Games Celebration on the Steam event page!

This is an online game sale event featuring indie games from East Asia including Taiwan, China, Japan, Korea, Hong Kong and Macau.


 Steam Event Page：https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45543967-East-Asia-Indie-Game-Developer/sale/eastasiaindiegames
 EAIGC official website：https://eaigc.filtergame.com/
 EAIGC Official X (Twitter)：https://x.com/eaigc_indie
 Period: August 5, 2025 (Tue) - August 19, 2025 (Tue)


【Campaign to recruit streamers for the demo version!】
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/0419d3453d0a9b3ee43cb0490bf7a9ff81218c82.gif
We are looking for a streamer to play the demo version of the ADV part of “Animaloid Girl”!
The demo version of the adventure part of the game will take about 15 minutes to play.


 Click here for application form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeI2jvMtLlzgWKJktRpXU2DOJnqms7fbG1JrW5LPNtewH4M7Q/viewform?usp=header
 Application Period：August 4, 2025 (Mon) ~ August 19, 2025 (Tue)

We would like many people to get to know “Animaloid Girl” through the event, so we are looking forward to receiving your applications!

notes.title: Notice of Release Date Postponement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/d57d51d008c16056c13cd993080e096964b3fde8.gif
【Notice of Release Date Postponement】
We have decided to change the release date of “Animaloid Girl” in order to make the “experience of spending time with a Animalized girl” even more ideal. We will let you know the details as soon as they are finalized.

We apologize for the delay.
We will continue to work hard on the development to create an experience that will remain in your memories for a lifetime!

notes.title: Main music by "Noriyuki Iwadare" & "Kowloonoid FM" pre-release!
notes.notes:
【Main music will be composed by "Noriyuki Iwadare"】
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/2c2cd086d681105df6adae0297610fdc286906f5.png
Noriyuki Iwadare, a musician who has composed music for Ace Attorney, GRANDIA, and Tokyo Disney Resort, will be the main musician for this title.
The playable demo at BitSummit Drift will include new music by Noriyuki Iwadare.
Together with the theme song composed by "DÉ DÉ MOUSE" already included in the PV, it will color the world of the Animaloid girl.
[previewyoutube=0Q8VM4zcJrU;full][/previewyoutube]


【A radio station appeared in the game! Linked with real distribution program on Youtube!】
[previewyoutube=W6Ich-kNTF8;full][/previewyoutube]
Kowloonoid FM, a fictional radio station, appears in the in-game world!
In the game, it is positioned as a popular music distribution radio for the residents and is involved in the storyline. You can freely listen to it as background music in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/a36796ca806c152dcee02878bbded1ae8bc6f05e.jpg
The first artist to participate in the music will be chiptune artist "Rei8Bit".

Furthermore, "Kowloonoid FM" will also appear in real life on Youtube!
The Youtube version will be a 24-hour Lo-Fi Music program.
The in-game "Kowloonoid FM" and the Youtube version of "Kowloonoid FM" will have a parallel world relationship, and although they are not the same, they will be linked so that the same music can be heard in the game, making the in-game world more familiar to the user, as if it were a real memory.
The Youtube version will play stills animated Live2D in-game + Lo-fi Music.
